controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by Kepler-186; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of this planet exists (it has never been resolved: only its transit depth and orbit are measured; see the investigation ledger). The gray marks an unresolved surface; the lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit.
